rows.label: Flat STR
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 STR = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: STR %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 STR = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: DEX
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 STR = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: Defense (flat) — Iron Wall converts a level-scaling % (10%+) into STR
rows.semantics: Iron Wall: a level-scaling share of the TOTAL Defense becomes STR (part of STAT_DAMAGE); no flat-Attack channel; PvP opponent Defense stays at the current value

rows.label: Defense %
rows.semantics: Iron Wall: a level-scaling share of the TOTAL Defense becomes STR (part of STAT_DAMAGE); no flat-Attack channel; PvP opponent Defense stays at the current value

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Weapon Acceleration's (Attack Speed) and Weapon Mastery's (Min Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Barricade Mastery's (Skill Damage, Max Damage), Power Stance's and Final Pact's (Final Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds Weapon Acceleration, Weapon Mastery, Barricade Mastery, Power Stance and Final Pact level deltas

rows.label: Pig's Ribbon
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)

rows.label: Mushmom's Cap
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (Accuracy vs Evasion not modelled)

rows.label: Lunar Dew
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)
